proof_body:
by
  intro V _ _ G _
  rw [← G.sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges]
  constructor
  · calc G.minDegree * Fintype.card V = ∑ _v : V, G.minDegree := by simp [mul_comm]
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun v _ => G.minDegree_le_degree v
  · calc ∑ v, G.degree v ≤ ∑ _v : V, G.maxDegree := Finset.sum_le_sum fun v _ => G.degree_le_maxDegree v
      _ = _ := by simp [mul_comm]
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj], G.minDegree * Fintype.card V ≤ 2 * G.edgeFinset.card ∧ 2 * G.edgeFinset.card ≤ G.maxDegree * Fintype.card V
